Total affordable = 8800 ÷ 240 = 36.67, rounded down to 36 items, of which 18 baskets and 18 wreaths; amount = 18×300 + 18×180 = 8640 CNY.
Quantity range: at lower unit price (combined 150 CNY) can buy 58 items, at upper unit price (combined 330 CNY) can buy 26 items, so the range is 26 - 58 items.
Conclusion: with budget 8800 CNY at average pricing one can buy 36 items for 8640 CNY; when actual price is higher the quantity trends toward 26, so stocking at the lower bound of the range is safer for quoting.
